g.text: Supported configuration pattern, NOT a deployed or Government-validated topology. App Service hosts are PaaS outside the VNet.
Existing operator-owned VNet and subnets | Terraform references, does not create
Private endpoint subnet | inbound service reachability
Easy Auth / app roles remain enabled
DINE policies manage zone groups + VNet links
Entra, own-cloud Graph, ARM and telemetry
Owner supplies DNS, routes and firewall policy
REFERENCE ONLY | Commercial and Government are explicit configurations, not hostname substitution.
Government Redis compatibility has a September 30, 2028 retirement gate; Responses needs independent verification and Government Anthropic is rejected.
This view neither certifies GCCH compliance nor proves private DNS, role propagation, model availability or a private deployment.
